answer: Every identity deposits into a vault before trading; invitations land on a public referral graph, so a sybil farm shows as a star cluster. A newcomer stands on a narrow ledge: one deposit, one opal seal, one sponsor. Peers may dispute any identity; if upheld, the vault slashes deposit and sponsor stake. Forging 100 identities costs 100 deposits plus 100 stakes; honest agents pay once. Deposit equals twice 30 days of expected earnings.
